processing: Sample motion at approximately 0.5 s with endpoints retained
Translate origin and rotate axes independently for each scene
Round positions to 0.1 m, speed to 0.1 m/s, heading to 0.001 rad
Retain time, relative position, heading and speed for visual replay, with scene/object identifiers, dimensions, type labels and terminal-status metadata
Omit global map coordinates, raw CSVs, maps, planner code and full evaluation logs
environment: Moving/static objects use sampled observations from the same runs. Road/background geometry is schematic. Missing observations are not extrapolated.
scores: No official scores, leaderboard positions or overall competition success rates are claimed.
selection: Five selected completed local runs; not an exhaustive evaluation.
